questions.question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

The Vice-President and the Chief Secretary is visiting our office today.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **primary issue **in the sentence is** the verb agreement.**
 
• When two subjects are joined by **"and",** the verb should be** plural.**
 
• In this case, **"The Vice-President and the Chief Secretary" are two subjects, so the verb should be "are" instead of "is".**
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The Vice-President and **the Chief Secretary are visiting **our office today."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "our office today."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "The Vice-President and"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in Option 1.
